ops.statement: The feedback step (durable AGENT_FEEDBACK.md entry + lessons-delta + invariant check) runs at the tail of a long context and is a predictable session-limit death point. A death there strands the durable retrospective even though mission commits are already on the branch. Recovery by a cold continuation is clean ONLY because the on-disk spine is canonical, the lease is --force re-claimable, and the workbench artifacts (RUN_SUMMARY, evidence, review surveys) are complete enough to reconstruct the entry without redoing analysis. Mitigation: checkpoint/draft the AGENT_FEEDBACK entry and lessons-delta earlier (e.g. at review), so a tail-end death cannot lose them.
